Он медленно покачал головой, и Леонсия резко вскрикнула, разочарованная в нём.", "source_sha256": "44616497162e47d0d3cc9d88036f58bb16a27dacdf390786ff34392f0c1fcf7e", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u006-r0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "03ab931d43861184c6882f240ad6cafee1db5df4b841749303bdc871b134e033"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u006-r0047", "target": "— Этот путь безнадёжен, — сказал он. — Зачем всем вам рисковать шеями в такой безрассудной затее, обречённой на провал с самого начала? — Говоря это, он перешёл от Леонсии к перилам так, чтобы на миг оказаться между Торресом и остальными, и в то же время сумел бросить предостерегающий взгляд на Энрико и его сыновей. — Что до Генри, то, похоже, для него всё кончено——", "source_sha256": "4d3ff890c97e5ea9f1067fd8f92c79c9f506f3e5a9f09aacdda57112fab14e68", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u006-r0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9e0e78300cebc8581addae170cb8127479542b9002cfed502cc1bc2684327156"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u006-r0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“You mean you doubt me?” Torres bristled.", "sha256": "6eafaa71cd3a014908eb7200814ba8918681a8bbf569ae7c22a86c382b041125", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[469]", "source_html": "

“You mean you doubt me?” Torres bristled.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u006-r0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“Heavens, man,” Francis protested.", "sha256": "ad8143cb536701f39b70e9228a8143e61df43cc66aa078b4ecd05a20a45ecefd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[470]", "source_html": "

“Heavens, man,” Francis protested.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u006-r0050", "tag": "p", "text": "But Torres dashed on: “You mean that I am forbidden by you, a man I have scarcely met, from the councils of the Solanos who are my oldest and most honored friends.”", "sha256": "a6f44838387cacfe0c2b8bf31758be057233df62b8763bdbbee888f83cbe87a3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[471]", "source_html": "

Old Enrico, who had not missed the rising wrath against Francis in Leoncia’s face, succeeded in conveying a warning to her, ere, with a courteous gesture, he hushed Torres and began to speak.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u006-r0052", "tag": "p", "text": "“There are no councils of the Solanos from which you are barred, Senor Torres. You are indeed an old friend of the family. Your late father and I were comrades, almost brothers. But that—and you will pardon an old man’s judgment—does not prevent Senor Morgan from being right when he says your plan is hopeless. To storm the jail is truly madness. Look at the thickness of the walls. They could stand a siege of weeks. And yet, and I confess it, almost was I tempted when you first broached the idea. Now when I was a young man, fighting the Indians in the high Cordilleras, there was a very case in point. Come, let us all be seated and comfortable, and I will tell you the tale....”", "sha256": "77ab72ba94653517aa57dc2d87ead4cb1e49616bc53a524c82c79f2b583454c8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[473]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u006-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "But Torres, busy with many things, declined to wait, and with soothed amicable feelings shook hands all around, briefly apologized to Francis, and departed astride his silver-saddled and silver-bridled horse for San Antonio. One of the things that busied him was the cable correspondence maintained between him and Thomas Regan’s Wall Street office. Having secret access to the Panamanian government wireless station at San Antonio, he was thus able to relay messages to the cable station at Vera Cruz. Not alone was his relationship with Regan proving lucrative, but it was jibing in with his own personal plans concerning Leoncia and the Morgans.", "sha256": "3e94590ab8351e266d1e47e27226b0a4e4d16f60384202e9dce1d5d90d2f4519", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[474]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u006-r0055", "tag": "p", "text": "“Nothing,” was the answer, “except that we do not need him, and that I’m not exactly infatuated with him. Now his plan is all right. We’ll go straight to the jail and take Henry out, if all you are game for it. And we don’t need to trust to a mob of unhung rascals and beach-sweepings.
